01 · Executive Summary

One system for your people, wherever they work

Dkhoni is one of the region's best-known fragrance brands. It sells oud, bakhoor, musk and perfume collections through its stores, online channels and wholesale business across Saudi Arabia and the GCC. A workforce of more than 1,200 people spread over many locations needs HR software that keeps up with the business: shift rosters for retail staff, attendance you can trust at every branch, accurate payroll and a clear view of the whole organisation.

Meagle360 HRMS handles all of this in one secure, cloud-based platform. It covers the full employee lifecycle from hiring to final settlement. We set it up around Dkhoni's own structure and policies. You do not have to change how you work to fit the software.

03 · The Complete HRMS

Every module included, in one subscription

There are no add-on packs and no premium tiers. Each module below is part of the 5 SAR per user plan.

01Core HR & Employee Directory

  • Central employee records, profiles and a searchable directory
  • Departments, designations, sites and reporting lines
  • Interactive organisation chart of the full hierarchy
  • Bulk onboarding with secure invite links

02Smart Attendance

  • Face-recognition check-in to stop proxy attendance
  • Geofencing so staff can only check in at their assigned store or site
  • Multi-site support for every branch and warehouse
  • Daily attendance views and exception alerts for managers

03Shift & Overtime Management

  • Shift templates and rotating rosters for retail teams
  • Seasonal schedules for Ramadan, Eid and sale periods
  • Overtime requests, approvals and automatic calculation
  • Holiday calendars by location

04Leave Management

  • Configurable leave types, accruals and balances
  • Multi-level approvals that follow your hierarchy
  • Team leave calendar so stores stay staffed
  • Policy-based rules and carry-forward

05Payroll Management

  • Salary structures, allowances and deductions
  • Attendance, leave and overtime flow into payroll automatically
  • Digital payslips in each employee's self-service portal
  • Employee bank details management for salary transfers

06Full & Final Settlement

  • Structured offboarding workflow
  • End-of-service gratuity and settlement calculation
  • Relieving and experience letters from a letter studio
  • Records of job changes, transfers and promotions

07Expense & Claims

  • Expense claims with bill and receipt uploads
  • Approval routing by department and amount
  • Reimbursements linked to payroll
  • Spend visibility by branch or team

08Recruitment & ATS

  • Job openings and a branded careers page
  • AI resume parsing and job-match scoring
  • Interview scheduling and hiring-team collaboration
  • Offer Letter Studio for professional offers

05 · Implementation Plan

From kick-off to go-live in 5–7 days

DAY 1

Discovery & kick-off

Map your company hierarchy, branches, shifts, leave and payroll policies and approval chains.

DAY 2

Structure & customisation

Set up departments, designations, sites and geofences, roles and permissions, plus any custom fields and workflows.

DAY 3–4

Data migration

Bulk-import all 1,200+ employee records, salary structures, leave balances and documents, then validate them with your HR team.

DAY 5

Testing & training

Run test payroll and attendance cycles. Train HR administrators and managers, and enrol employee faces for attendance.

DAY 6–7

Go-live & hyper-care

Send employee invites and launch across all locations, with dedicated support during the first weeks.
